title: Income Tax Rules, 2002

verification.note: Demonstration extract for layout only. Confirm the S.R.O. number and text against the Gazette before quoting.

preamble: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 237 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, the Federal Board of Revenue is pleased to make the following rules.

sections.title: Short title and commencement
text: (1) These rules may be called the Income Tax Rules, 2002.
(2) They shall come into force on the first day of July, 2002.
